thumbs.title: Why The Battle of Midway Was NOT Bad Luck
thumbs.background: a bright Pacific ocean seen from slightly above, three Japanese aircraft carriers (wooden flight decks with a big red circle painted on them) burning with orange flames and thick black smoke columns, three dark-blue American dive bombers with white stars diving out of white clouds toward them

characters.name: Vice-Admiral Chuichi Nagumo
characters.position: right 40% of the frame, big bust, head top at about 18% from the top, turned toward the burning ships on the left
characters.extra: Two big blue cartoon sweat drops fly off his head.

symbols: a thick red curved arrow from the American planes down to the burning carriers
thumbs.light: warm orange firelight on the admiral's face from the left, bright midday sky, glow behind the admiral's head
thumbs.palette: deep ocean blue and sky blue against orange fire and black smoke, white sailor whites, one yellow accent in the headline
fix_tips: If the face is too small, ask for 'bigger head, closer crop'.
If the model adds more text, repeat 'only the words THEY KNEW.'.

thumbs.title: The Fake Message That REALLY Won Midway
thumbs.background: a saturated poster-style political map of the Pacific Ocean: bright blue sea, Japan and its empire in red at the far left, Hawaii in blue at the right, thick white borders
thumbs.middle: the tiny Midway atoll circled by a thick glowing red ring with a white label box 'MIDWAY', a dashed red arrow from Japan to it, and a crumpled telegram paper floating above with a red stamp

characters.name: Admiral Isoroku Yamamoto
characters.position: far left, large bust cropped by the left and bottom edges, facing right
characters.extra: One big blue sweat drop on his temple.

characters.name: Commander Joseph Rochefort, US Navy codebreaker
characters.look: elderly, balding with grey tufts at the sides, wearing a dark red smoking jacket over khaki trousers, kind wrinkled face
characters.position: far right, large bust cropped by the right and bottom edges, facing left
characters.target: the Midway ring in the centre

labels.style: a black box with bold white chalk-style text

thumbs.light: even bright light, soft rim light on both characters to separate them from the map
thumbs.palette: electric blue sea, red Japan, white borders, khaki and dark red on the characters
